customers_say: Customers find this water purifier to be a best-in-class product with excellent value for money, and appreciate its immediate installation and good taste. However, the reliability receives mixed feedback - while some say it works well, others report it stops working. Moreover, durability and leakage are significant concerns, with customers reporting damage within three months and water leakage issues. Additionally, the water wastage feature receives mixed reviews, with customers questioning its effectiveness.
